name: motion-domino-chain
title: Cause-and-effect Chain
description: Chín quân domino đổ lần lượt, mỗi quân trễ 120 ms như quân trước làm đổ quân sau.

moworks.author: moworks

options.standAt: s after the start to stand back up (null)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Nine dominoes (8×50 px, 30 px apart, pivot at the base): each tips 0 → 66° in 250 ms power2.in, 120 ms after the previous, so each fall seems to cause the next (recipe: element n starts at n × 100 ms, 400 ms ease-out each; 2–6 frames apart, never all at once). Small demo: all stand back up over 300 ms. Params: angle (66°) · each (0.25 s) · stagger (0.12 s) · pivot (đáy).
